# Menufy

> > Menufy is a restaurant online ordering and website platform serving independent restaurants across the United States.

Menufy provides white-label websites and online ordering solutions for local restaurants, enabling establishments like pizza food trucks, Thai restaurants, and Indian eateries to manage their digital presence and accept orders. The platform serves diverse restaurant types across multiple states including Washington, South Carolina, and Massachusetts.

## Key Topics

- Online ordering platform
- Restaurant websites
- Local restaurant marketing
- Wood-fired pizza
- Authentic Thai cuisine
- Indian restaurant dining
- Carryout and delivery
- Award-winning restaurants
- Gluten-free options
- Vegetarian options
- Full-bar dining
- Drive-thru service
- Custom pizza ordering
- Restaurant reservations
- Independent restaurant technology

## Featured Restaurant Partners

- [Just A Pizza My Mind - Award-Winning Pizza Food Truck](https://justapizzamymind.menufy.com/): Award-winning wood-fired pizza food truck in Milton, WA, featured in Seattle Times, South Sound Magazine, and News Tribune. Offers Detroit-style pizza, gluten-free options, and drive-thru service.
- [Thai Zapp Restaurant and Bar](https://thaizapp.menufy.com/): Authentic Thai restaurant and full bar in Charleston, South Carolina, offering reservations, carryout, delivery, and vegetarian options.
- [Athidi Indian Restaurant](https://athidius.menufy.com/): Traditional Indian restaurant in Saugus near Boston, specializing in biryani and authentic Indian cuisine with carryout and delivery services.
